title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-08
lineage: AKG190E > Uher 400L MR; Audience master reel > (possibly one extra reel gen?) > modified Technics 1506 playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > CD > CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking > SHN

ai_review.summary: A solid early‑era audience fragment that captures the legendary 11‑8‑69 show’s epic Dark Star/Other One marathon.
ai_review.review: The short AUD recording is surprisingly clear for its vintage, offering a taste of Marty Weinberg’s famed tape. Reviewers rave about the concert itself – the rolling Dark Star → The Other One → Dark Star sequence, Uncle John's Jam and the soaring Caution are highlighted as career‑high moments. While the fragment’s brevity limits its usefulness, the sound quality is good for an audience source and gives listeners a glimpse of one of the Dead’s most celebrated shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the show’s musical brilliance, but note the recording is only a brief audience excerpt; overall rating balances strong performance with limited recording scope.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early‑era audience tape – clear enough for its time, but very short (partial fragment). Listeners appreciate the vintage vibe yet wish for more length.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans describe the second set as an "aural spectacle" with seamless, improvisational segues that build a powerful narrative from Dark Star through Caution.
